message: Established concrete Style tokens from the brand kit and reference analyses, including Palette, Typography, Composition, Pacing, MotionRules, Keep, Avoid, and References.

Palette.Name: background.primary
Palette.Usage: Primary canvas background across all beats

Palette.Name: text.primary
Palette.Usage: Headlines, KPI numerals, and primary labels

Palette.Name: accent.primary
Palette.Usage: Primary chart series and focal highlights

Palette.Name: accent.positive
Palette.Usage: Positive delta badges and expansion metrics

Style.Composition: Eye goes first to the primary KPI numeral at upper-center, then to the supporting label and chart below.

Pacing.HoldRules: Hold settled KPI figures and the final poster frame for at least 1.5s before transitions.

MotionRules.Notes: Count-up settles at least 1.5s before beat end

Style.Texture: Subtle 1px slate hairline borders (#1E293B) over deep navy surface
Keep: Monospace tabular numerals for all bound metrics
Avoid: The reference deck's proprietary company logo and wordmark in the top-right corner
Verbatim customer quote text and named enterprise logos on slide 2
The specific isometric server-rack illustration on the cover frame

References.PaletteLearned: Deep slate-navy background (#0B1020) with crisp off-white typography (#F8FAFC) and single-hue electric cyan (#38BDF8) data highlights.
References.TypographyLearned: Heavy geometric sans-serif display headings paired with medium monospace numerals for KPI figures and generous line height.
References.CompositionLearned: Asymmetric two-column layout with primary KPI numeral anchored at upper-left and wide 8% outer safe margins.
References.PacingLearned: Measured 5-second beat cadence with at least 1.5 seconds of static hold after each counter settles.
References.MotionLearned: Calm, high-damping cubic-bezier entrances with staggered vertical reveals.
References.TextureLearned: Subtle 1px slate hairline borders separating metric cards over flat dark surfaces.
DoNotCopy: The reference deck's proprietary company logo and wordmark in the top-right corner
Verbatim customer quote text and named enterprise logos on slide 2
The specific isometric server-rack illustration on the cover frame

reasoning: Applied brand kit ColorToken palette and MJ Sans / MJ Mono TypeSpec rules with explicit Composition, Pacing, and MotionRules suited to executive financial reporting.
